scope: Every file classified as upstream-modified in compliance/provenance.json.
policy: Apache-2.0 Section 4(b) requires modified files to carry prominent notices stating that they were changed when the work is redistributed. Source distributions must add a per-file notice or an equivalent per-file change manifest. Compiled client distributions must include ATTRIBUTION.md, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md, and the generated change manifest with the modification statement. Release mode remains blocked until legal review approves the chosen distribution notice. A NOTICE file and a generated per-file change manifest accompany distributions; legal review must confirm they satisfy Section 4(b) for the chosen distribution form.
